s: Din heak modedin alpayim amma ubo y"d seipim: habba limdod alpayim amma shel techum hair, im yesh lair d' zaviyyot, apillu enah merubbaat mammash, sheen rochbah keorkah ella arukka uqetzara, o shehayeta merubbaat velo leribbua haolam veyesh lah d' zaviyyot — mannichim otah kemot shehi, umodedin lah alpayim amma mikkol ruach mid' ruchoteha. Abal im hi agulla, sheen lah zaviyyot — lo yimdod lah mechomatah sabib, ella roim otah keillu hi betok merubba sheorko keorkah verochbo kerochbah, umodedim chutz mitztzalot oto merubba, shennimtza mistakker hazzaviyyot, kezeh. Shellamedu chakamim mimmigreshe hearim shehayu merubbaim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"t. Veken im hair hi meshulleshet, o sheyyesh lah tzelaot rabbot vezaviyyot rabbot — merabbeim otah ribbua sheorko keorkah verochbo kerochbah hayyoter gadol, veachar kak motziim hachut chutz lammerubba alpayim amma lekol ruach. Ukeshehu merabbea — merabbeah leribbua haolam, kede shettehe kol ruach mimmenna meshuka keneged ruach meruchot haolam umekuvvenet kenegdah, velo tehe baalaksono shel olam:

Veken ir sheenah muqqepet choma chalaqa ella battim semukim umechubbarim, veyesh bayit niknas letok hair yoter mechabero o yotze ubolet min hair yoter mechabero, veken ir hammuqqepet lah choma veen kol hachoma yeshara ella yesh bah meqomot boletin mimmenna — roim keillu chut matuach al pene kullah keneged maqom hachitzon habbolet mimmenna, umoded min hachut ulechutz alpayim, kede sheyyehe hattechum shaveh beyosher keneged kol hair. Vaapillu yesh lah belita letzad mizrach uletzad maarab — roin keillu chut matuach alehem bekol tzad, kezeh:

Ayr haasuya kemin ga"m o keqeshet, im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mid' alapim amma, shettechum roshah zeh nibla betok techum roshah hashsheni — naaset ir achat umodedin lah min hayyeter, veroin et kol harochab shebben hayyeter vehaqqeshet keillu hu male battim (veim hayyeter shemmerosh zeh lerosh zeh beir haasuya kemin ga"m yihyeh matuach laalaksono shel olam — mosipin alayv ribbua, veken beir haasuya keqeshet):

Vaapillu im yesh meemtzait hayyeter velaqqeshet yoter mealpayim amma, shehayyotze mibbeto shebbeqeshet tzarik lelek techum shalem ad sheyyaggia layyeter — ap al pi ken modedin lo min hayyeter, lepi sheim haya rotzeh haya yakol lehallek derek habbattim sebib haqqeshet ad sheyyaggia leechad min harashim, umishsham yakol lehallek bekol orek hayyeter apillu lerosh hashsheni, shehare techumehem niblaim zeh bezeh. Vekevan shebbehetter yakol lehallek limqom hayyeter — shub en maqom hechalaq oser alayv, veroim oto keillu hu male battim vachatzerot. Veim en meemtzait hayyeter velaqqeshet yoter mealpayim, apillu yesh ben b' harashim yoter mid' alapim amma — modedin lah min hayyeter, shehare yakol lehallek behetter derek hayyeter merosh zeh lerosh zeh, kevan shehayyeter hu mubla bitchum haqqeshet, vahare zeh kimhallek derek batte haqqeshet*mah sheen ken bisip ch'. Veshappir maqsheh hatam raba miyyoter mealpayim dehaka letok alpayim dehatam. Veabbayye eno tzarik letaretz keterutz rishon shel hattosepot sham ella keterutz b', vaapillu haki chashash hattur lisbarat terutz ha' kemo shechashash lisbarat terutz hag', ap al gab deen tzarik kelal, ella disbara hu, haka nami sebara hu delekka lememar mali (ulepi zeh apillu bepachot mid' alapim asur laemtzait, kevan delekka lememar mali, velo derek battim leyeter, ayyen rashi"y, ukeillu enah kelal, dehablaat techumin kehay gavna lav milleta hi. Verabba bar rab huna sebira leh mali beqeshet vaapillu haki asur bed' alapim, kemo shetztzarik lomar leterutz hab'). Vedo"q demukrach hu belav haki, deim lo ken ap sheyyesh lehaemtzai yoter mealpayim lishtere mishshum mali, ap delekka lememar ate derek battim. Veap lepi terutz ha' vehag' al kol panim lachitzonim lishtere.:

Abal im yesh meemtzait hayyeter laqqeshet yoter mealpayim amma, uben b' harashim yesh d' alapim amma — modedin lah min hammaqom shennitqatztzer sham haqqeshet, sheen ben b' rashim d' alapim o sheen meemtzait hayyeter laqqeshet yoter mealpayim amma. Umikkol maqom apillu bene otah haqqeshet mammash holekim kol ribbua shel qeshet veiggulo ad rosh hashsheni, umishsham veelak alpayim, ella sheasurim labo derek hayyeter shebbenehem haarok d' alapim veeno mubla bitchum haqqeshet:

Kol bet dira shehu yotze mehair, ap al pi sheen darim bo atta ella shehu rauy ledira, sheyyesh bo d' ammot al d' ammot, im en beno uben hair ella a' amma veshirayim, shehem b' shelishe amma veod mashshehu — shezzehu shiur tzela echad mitztzalot bet satayim hammerubbaot mammash — hare zeh mitztarep lair venechshab mimmenna. Ukeshemmodedin lah alpayim amma — motechim chut al pene kol rochbah chutz lebet dira zeh, umishsham modedim lah alpayim amma. Veyesh omerim shemmarchiqim mishsham od a' amma veshirayim, umatchilim limdod. Veen tzarik lomar sheim en bet dira samuk lair, umodedin mehair atzmah, shemmarchiqim mechomatah a' amma veshirayim, shekkol a' amma veshirayim hassemukim lair niqraim ibburah shel ir venechshabim kair. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim. Abal bayit echad, apillu gadol harbeh — en lo din ir latet lo a' amma veshirayim keir, im eno omed betok a' amma veshirayim lair:

Haya bayit qarob lair ke' amma, ubayit sheni qarob larishon ke' amma, ubayit g' qarob leb' ke' amma, veken ad mahalak kamma yamim, hare hakkol keir achat, ukeshemmodedim — modedim michutz le' amma mibbayit haacharon. Veim hayu battim kaellu keneged b' rashe hair bilbad, umikkeneged emtzaah hu chalaq, veyesh mibbayit haacharon shekkeneged rosh zeh ad bayit haacharon shekkeneged rosh zeh d' alapim amma, umehem lair yoter mealpayim amma — enan mitztorpin zeh im zeh lihyot ir achat velimtoach chut mizzeh lezeh al pene kol hair velimdod mishsham alpayim mikkol hair, kemo shennitbaer beir haasuya keqeshet. Veim en battim kaellu yotzeim ella keneged rosh echad bilbad, ubayit haacharon rachoq min hair yoter mealpayim — en motechim chut kenegdo al pene orek kol hair im yesh beorkah yoter mealpayim, sheaz mah shehu chutz lealpayim beorek hair, kevan shemmaqom hechalaq shekkenegdo eno mubla betok techum battim hayyotzeim keneged rosh hair, hare hi ola lo mikkelal alpayim shel techum shabbat, lepi sheeno nechshab mikkelal hair. Abal maqom hechalaq shebbetok alpayim lebattim shekkeneged rosh hair — hu nechshab mikkelal hair, vehaddarim kenegdo modedim alpayim chutz mimmennu, dehaynu keneged bayit haacharon mibbattim hayyotzeim keneged rosh hair:

Kol bayit sheeno asuy ledira, im darim bo — mitztarep lair im hu betok shibim amma veshirayim lair, kegon bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo dira lechazzan hakkeneset, ubet aboda zara sheyyesh bo dira lekohaneha, vehaurvot shel susim vehaotzarot shel tebua sheyyesh bahen dira lehashshomer. Veken bet haqqebarot shehashshomer dar bimchitztzotayv, ap al pi sheen sham binyan meyuchad lehashshomer, shebbinyan hammeyuchad lekak — bayit gamur hu. Vaapillu en darim bo atta, mitztarep lair im yesh bo d' ammot al d' ammot kemo shennitbaer. Veken gesher sheyyesh bo dira lehammokes, kegon sheyyesh lo ketalim tachtayv ella shehakkippa chalula, veyesh bakketalim pillush sheyyaabru sham hammayim, vehammokes dar biktalim ellu. (Veken) g' mechitztzot, ap al pi sheen alehem tiqra (vedarim benehem, o shennisharu mibbayit gamur) — chashubot kebayit gamur im gebohot y' tepachim, vehu sheyyehe bahen d' ammot al d' ammot. Veken b' mechitztzot sheyyesh alehen tiqra umaaziba (veg' mechitztzot sheyyesh alehen tiqra umaaziba, ap al pi sheen darim sham — bayit gamur hu) abal b' mechitztzot sheen alehem tiqra umaaziba ap al pi sheddarim benehem, veken hashshobak vehabbor veshiach umeara ap al pi sheddarim bahen — en diratan kelum veenan mitztorpim lair. Veim yesh binyan al pene hammeara — hare kol hammeara chashuba dira al yede binyan sheal piha. Veen matchilin limdod ella missop hammeara im habbinyan hu betok shibim amma lair. Vehu sheyyesh bo d' ammot al d' ammot. Veim en bo d' ammot — hammeara mashlimato led' ammot, im yesh bo rob had' ammot:

Bayit habbanuy bayyam, sheasuy lepannot bo et hakkelim shebbassepina, mitztarep lair im hu betok a' amma veshirayim. Abal habbayit shebbassepina haomedet samuk lair eno mitztarep lair, mippene sheeno qabua sham, sheppeamim hu betok [a' amma] lair upeamim sheeno. Veken habburganin sheosin shomere happerot begannot upardesim o shomere hair chutz lair enan mitztorpin immahem, mippene shehem aray, mippene haggannabim umippene haggeshamim sheshshotepim otam im hu maqom shemmetzuyim bo gannabim o geshamim sheshshotepim habburgenim. Abal bemaqom sheenan metzuyin — hare ellu mitztorpin lair, veyakol lehallek apillu kamma parsaot al yede burganin hammublain zeh betok a' amma shel zeh, veken bekol ellu shemmitztorpin lair:
Bayit sheen berochbo d' ammot, ap al pi shearok meod — eno niqra bayit:

Hayu b' ayarot zo semuka lezo qm"a amma ushelish (veod dabar muat), kede sheyyihyeh benehen a' amma veshirayim lezo ve' amma veshirayim lezo — chashubot shettehen keir achat, venimtzet kol ir mehen mehalleket et kol hair hashsheniyya vechutza lah alpayim amma. Veken chomat hair shennipretza mib' ruchoteha zo keneged zo, vecharebu habbattim shebbenehen ad shennaasu keb' ayarot, im en berochab maqom hechalaq ella qm"a amma ushelish — dino kesatum. Abal bayit echad, apillu gadol harbeh meod, ap al pi sheen beno lair qm"a ammot — eno mitztarep immah, ad sheyyihyeh lah betok shibim amma veshirayim, lepi sheen notenim shum ibbur lebayit ella leir bilbaddah:

Hayu shelosha keparim meshullashim keshalosh ragle haqqanqan, im en ben haemtzait lekol echad mehachitzonim yoter mealpayim — anu roin oto keillu hu mubla benehem. Veim keshehaya mubla benehem lo haya mimmennu lekol echad mehachitzonim yoter miqam"a amma ushelish, vahare kullam keir achat — hare hem akshav gam ken keir achat, umodedim lahem alpayim lekol ruach michutz lishloshtan. Vaapillu im yesh ben hachitzonim yoter mid' alapim amma — mitztorpim zeh im zeh im haemtzai hu gadol kol kak ad sheim haya mubla ben hachitzonim lo haya mimmennu lekol echad mehem yoter miqam"a ushelish, shekkevan sheanu roim keillu haemtzai mubla ben hachitzonim — mah lanu lammerchaq shebben hachitzonim. Veenan domim leir heasuy keqeshet, sheim yesh ben b' harashim d' alapim enan mitztorpim zeh im zeh, lepi shei epshar lirot keillu haqqeshet mubla bimqom hayyeter ben harashim, shehare haqqeshet hu gadol mehayyeter. Lepikak im kepar haemtzai hu gadol mehammerchaq shebben hachitzonim — en roin oto keillu hu mubla benehem, umodedim lekol echad leatzmo. Veap al pi sheen mimmennu lekol echad mehem yoter mealpayim — eno mitztarep immahem (im yesh ben hachitzonim d' alapim), veenan domim leir haasuya keqeshet, sheim en miqqeshet leemtzait hayyeter yoter mealpayim mitztorpim harashim zeh im zeh venaaseh hakkol ir achat (apillu yesh benehem yoter mid' alapim), lepi shehamhallek bayyeter merosh zeh lerosh zeh hu mehallek behetter keillu mehallek bebatte haqqeshet, kevan shehayyeter hu mubla bitchuman. Mah sheen ken kan, shehamhallek mechitzon lechitzon — ap im tachshebehu keillu mehallek derek haemtzai, hoil vehu mubla bitchumayv — eno mehallek behetter (sheapillu im en mechitzon lechitzon yoter mealpayim, mikkol maqom kevan sheggam im haya mehallek derek haemtzai lo haya zeh moil lo shello yihyeh zeh oleh lo min hammidda, sheyyehe yakol lelek od alpayim chutz lechitzon — laken gam akshav, shemmehallek shello bederek haemtzai, hare zeh oleh lo lemiddat techumo. Mah sheen ken beir haasuya keqeshet, sheim haya mehallek derek batte haqqeshet lo haya zeh oleh lemiddat techumo — laken gam keshemmehallek bayyeter eno oleh lo bemiddato, hoil vehu mubla bitchum haqqeshet). Umittaam zeh im yesh meemtzai lachitzonim yoter mealpayim, sheen roin oto keillu hu mubla benehem — en hachitzonim mitztorpim zeh im zeh apillu en benehem d' alapim, kol sheyyesh benehem yoter miqam"a ushelish. Veenan domim leir haasuya keqeshet, sheim en ben b' harashim d' alapim mitztorpim zeh im zeh ap al pi sheyyesh ben yeter laqqeshet yoter mealpayim, lepi sheim haya rotzeh haya yakol lelek derek batte haqqeshet, kemo shennitbaer lemala, mah sheen ken kan sheen battim lechabberam. Veyesh omerim sheap sheen mehaemtzai lachitzonim alpayim — en roim oto keillu hu mubla benehem ella leinyan shehachitzonim mitztorpim zeh im zeh veim haemtzai. Abal haemtzai modedim lo alpayim mechomato, lepi sheim nireh oto kemubla veomed ben hachitzonim — yapsid kol kak leruach hashshenit sheenah letzad hachitzonim (uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, umodedim lehaemtzai alpayim michutz lachitzonim, veap al pi ken lo hipsid leruach hashshenit):

Ir sheyyoshebet al sepat hannachal sherob haittim hu yabesh — sheeno male ella bishat haggeshem — im yesh lepaneha matztzeba rochab d' ammot al sepat hannachal, kede sheyyaamdu aleha veyishtammeshu bannachal, nimtza hannachal biklal hair umodedim lah alpayim amma missepat hannachal hab', venaaseh hannachal kullo mikkelal hair mippene hammatztzeba habbenuya betziddo. Veim en bammatztzeba rochab d' ammot — en tashmisham aleha bannachal noach, mippene shemmityorim shello yippelu bannachal, veen modedim lahem ella mippetach battim hachitzonim hassemukim lannachal, venimtza hannachal nimdad min haalpayim shellahem. Veyesh lehistappeq im bekol maqom shemmishtammeshim sham bene hair betashmish noach natchil limdod mishsham:

Yoshebe tzeripim, dehaynu sheyyoshebim beohalim sheosin mehutzin vaaraba, veenan qebuim bemaqom echad ella yoshebim kan zeman ma ad sheyyikleh hammireh veachar kak holekim lemaqom acher — modedim lekol echad veechad mippetach oholo. Veap al pi shekkol ohalim semukim zeh lezeh, en modedim meohel hachitzon kemo beir, shemmodedim mibbayit hachitzon ap al pi sheenah muqqepet choma, shekkevan sheen haohalim qebuim — en lahem din ir. Umikkol maqom im hem muqqapim kullam bimchitztza gaboah y' tepachim, o becharitz amoq y' tepachim shehu nechshab kimchitztza — hare kol haheqqep nechshab ked' ammot im huqqap ledira, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"v. Veim yesh sham g' chatzerot shel b' b' battim qebuim shel eben o shel nesarim — hare ellu osin et kol haohalim qeba, veyesh lahem din ir, umerabbeim otah venotenim lah alpayim lekol ruach kishar haayarot. Ir shehuqqepa velibsop yoshba — im enah meyushshebet kullah ad hachoma, keshebba limdod techumeha lo yimdod mehachoma ella michutz le' amma veshirayim mehabbattim, shehachoma hi keillu enah, lepi sheal yede hachoma lo naasa haheqqep shebbetokah ked' ammot, hoil velo hiqqipuha ledira. Umikkol maqom im yesh bachoma bet dira, vehi betok a' amma veshirayim leyishshub batte hair — modedim michutz le' amma veshirayim mibbet dira zeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im yoshba velibsop huqqepa — hare zeh huqqap ledira, umodedim michutz leshibim mechomatah bekol inyan:
